name: hcapp_getResetCode
description: Returns the ResetCode (URC:-prefixed invite/QR code) for the Hasher identified by the given SupportCode. The SupportCode is a short USC:-prefixed code visible on the user's profile, used for admin-assisted device re-authorisation. Any authenticated user may call this endpoint. Removed users are excluded. Returns a standard HC6 error rowset if not found or auth fails. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 13, @param NULL). Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown. Platform admins only (HC.PlatformAdmin, removed = 0): any other caller gets the error detail rowset with errorCode 1312 / errorType 13 'Not authorised', logged to HC.ErrorLog (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth to authenticate the caller.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic auth token. Validated by HC6.ValidateAppAuth against the device secret.

parameters.name: supportCode
parameters.description: The USC:-prefixed support code to look up. Matched against HC.Hasher.SupportCode. Defaults to NULL when omitted (2026-10-13).
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(250) vs Hasher.SupportCode NVARCHAR(50) — parameter is 5× wider than the column. Should be NVARCHAR(50).

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when HC6.ValidateAppAuth fails (auth, device not found, or token expired). Uses camelCase column names matching the HC6 standard app error format.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry recorded by ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code set by ValidateAppAuth.

rowsets.name: NotFoundError
rowsets.description: Returned when no active Hasher matches the supplied supportCode (errorCode=1313, errorType=13). Uses the same camelCase structure as AuthError.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry recorded for this not-found event.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: Always 'No active account was found for that support code.'.

rowsets.name: ResetCodeResult
rowsets.description: Returned on success. Single row containing the URC:-prefixed reset code for the matched user.

columns.name: resetCode
columns.description: The URC:-prefixed invite/reset code from HC.Hasher.ResetCode. Column declared NVARCHAR(250) in SP but column is NVARCHAR(50) in table.

rowsets.name: NotAuthorisedError
rowsets.description: Caller is not a platform admin: single error detail rowset {errorId, errorType 13, errorCode 1312, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc}. Logged before return; no transaction is open.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog (with string_1 = @supportCode) when no active Hasher matches (lines 82-85), and from the CATCH block (lines 98-100, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.
@supportCode is declared NVARCHAR(250) but HC.Hasher.SupportCode is NVARCHAR(50). Narrowed from HC5's NVARCHAR(1000) but still 5× wider than the column. Should be NVARCHAR(50).
Local variable @resetCode is declared NVARCHAR(250) but HC.Hasher.ResetCode is NVARCHAR(50). Functionally harmless but inconsistent — should match the column type.

breakingChanges: @supportCode narrowed from NVARCHAR(1000) (HC5) to NVARCHAR(250) (HC6). Any caller passing a string longer than 250 characters will receive a truncation error.

Not-found case now returns a structured HC6 error rowset (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc) instead of HC5's single-column 'Support code not found' string result in the LookupResult rowset. Callers must be updated to check for the error rowset rather than parsing the result string.
Auth failure now returns the standard HC6 ValidateAppAuth error rowset instead of HC5's non-standard Pascal-cased error rowset (ErrorType, ErrorTitle, ErrorDescription).

Removed users are now excluded from lookup results. HC5 returned a 'Support code not found' result for removed users implicitly via the removed=0 filter; HC6 is explicit and consistent but the observable behaviour is the same.
errorCode 1313 and errorType 13 are new — HC5 had no structured error codes for this SP.
